# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before proposing or modifying code, read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the authoritative contract [`Zap_Platform_Codex_Prompt.md`](../Zap_Platform_Codex_Prompt.md). Copilot should not assume that either file is loaded automatically.

Preserve the existing Node.js/TypeScript Fastify modular monolith, React/Vite admin/company/professional applications, Hostinger-compatible SQL migrations, API boundaries and RBAC roles. Keep SQL behind the API, avoid unnecessary dependencies or caching layers, make minimal scoped changes, and keep all user-facing content in Brazilian Portuguese (`pt-BR`). Run relevant checks/tests and never perform destructive database operations without explicit approval.
